result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by expressly eliminating liquidated damages and penalties. However, it is not minimal because it adds schedule relief and an uncapped right to recover additional time-and-materials costs, neither of which is required by the playbook rule. It nevertheless preserves the clause’s underlying commercial purpose by providing Vendor relief for Customer-caused dependency delays. The drafting is generally professional, though “affected obligations and dates” could be more precise.
